notes.title: 🌊 Pool Party Update is LIVE! 🌊 + 💦 Summer Splash Contest 🏆
notes.notes:
🥳 Let's have a party! 🥳


Aaaaaand another big update is here, bringing new features, Items, and, most importantly, things from Players!


Throw Party, Piano, or duck to your friend while playing co-op! 🦆


[previewyoutube="YALnCVrb7aE;full"][/previewyoutube]

On our Roadmap, if something is highlighted, then it's from your suggestions or ideas, which were mentioned 🥰 



We are really happy that the interactive Roadmap on Canny has been positively received from you guys!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/307e7889b221c2c9a08f26beb2e62650d5b11881.png"]



Full changelog here and also in-game:



New:

• New job: "Save our summer!" (in Coralroot Forest). Unlocked by completing either of two jobs "Setting up a movie set" or "Making room for our new baby"

• New house: "Pool party aftermath"

• 4 new patio furniture assemblies.

• Proper pool placement system! No more cursed workarounds! Now you can:

	• Resize pools.

	• Connect multiple pools – even if their bottoms are different depths.

	• Tile every surface separately.

	• Build inside and around them - DIY your own stairs or make custom tile patterns. (Pixel art pool tiles, anyone?)

	• Add lights, ladders, drains... go wild!

• A lot of new items! (Full list below)

• Item collections while buying – it’s easier to buy similar items like mugs, books, cabinets, and plant pots. We will be adding more collections in the future!

• Throw and drop items with the new Throw Mode added to Hands (available in both Sandbox Mode and Story Mode!).

• Occasional decorations (like Halloween, Winter) have been moved to their own separate category in the Store

• Added a sub-category for plants that can be placed inside vases

137 new items! 

• A fully customizable, resizable pool! 

• A water gun - pick it up and shoot your shot

• A car - just one...for now ;) 

• 4 new patterns - usable on furniture and as wallpapers 

• A new kind of tiny fence

• 6 new basic doors 

• A firefighter helmet

• Beach towel

• Pool slides

• Pool drains & fountains

• Pool filter & ladder

• Water sprinkler

• 6 fire pits and a patio heater

• A modular bar table and stool, made to circle around the tall fire pits

• Hydrangea

• Juniper

• Banana trees

• Prickly pear cactus

• Bird of paradise plant

• Fruit bowls - with and without the fruit ;) 

• A camping bed - for sleeping on-site!

• A camera and tripod it slots into

• 11 items for fishing and diving hobbies

• Trekking poles

• 6 new small toys like a cute octopus and pufferfish

• More inflatable toys

• And 37 decorations! Including:

    • Flower heads and bouquets for sunflowers, roses, crocuses, lenten roses, hyacinths, daffodils, and tulips

    • Crow figurines

    • Foxy figurines

    • A golden pineapple

    • Seashells and starfish

    • 3 vases

    • 5 candleholders

    • A tea light candle

    • A new clock

Changes:

• Huge performance improvements!!!

• \[UI] Refreshed the "Change style" panel for furniture and wall/floor/ceiling materials.

	• Parts within items like door handles and sinks now have pictures showing the styles.

	• Color and material tooltip names are now visible in the main view.

	• Choosing colors for patterns has been reworked.

• Cushions can now be flipped (press V)

• Changed the main menu art to Summer ;)

• You can put pens and pencils into office organizers.

• Items snap into sockets much more easily than before (e.g., shaving razor & shaving stand)

• Items that are resized while buying will now keep their size.

• Re-enabled ignoring collisions when resizing in Story Mode.

• Auto-grass cutting with rotated objects should now be a bit more accurate.

• Before-after sequences can be instantly rewatched. Because why not admire your work twice?

• You can use "Open in Store" for items and surface finishes with most Architect Tool and Flipper Tool modes.

• It’s now easier to unlock the “Hello” achievement if you missed it earlier. Any job related to Tom Marino will do.

• Unified which buttons are used for "Context Tool Action" and "Change Mode / Open Options" for all tools across Architect and Flipper mode.

• Changed the button for dropping items in Architect Mode with the Transform Tool. Don't be surprised.

• In Sandbox Mode, “Reset Progress” was renamed to “Start Over” and immediately loads the level.

• A Bessie pop-up appears if we detect any external issues with saving like insufficient disk space.

Co-op changes:

• Phone calls are now fully synced.

• Recap screens now appear for everyone.

• Third-person animations got smoother in multiplayer.

• Improved VFX when using detergent.

• More sounds are now synchronized.

• Other players now get appropriately paid in co-op. 

Fixes:

• Flipping molding upside-down no longer flips the stairs.

• Jobs unlocked by new updates no longer make archived jobs disappear.

• Grass growth and cutting should now behave more predictably.

• Sandbox Mode: Unpacking box operations (like cloning) are more stable now.

Co-op fixes:

• Joining after the host sold something no longer breaks the session.

• Host won’t get stuck on the loading screen if someone joins mid-load.

• Internet hiccups during startup no longer cause an incomplete list of available regions.

• Selling a roof mid-customization no longer blocks players. Roof drama resolved.

• Budget now syncs properly when a new player joins mid-session.

• Surface finishing tools sync their state correctly upon new player entry.

• Surface materials held by players now sync as they should.

• Paint area markers now properly disappear if another player demolishes the painted wall. No more painting into the void.


Important: The upside-down pools have stopped working. Please use the newly introduced pools 🙏


Update should be available now to download, if you don't have it, reset Steam or wait around 2 Hours

 
[hr][/hr]

🎥 Stream Q&A with Jerma! + Summer Splash Contest 💦


Friendly reminder, there will be a Q&A Stream with Jerma in 3 days! 



[dynamiclink href="https://www.twitch.tv/frozen_district"][/dynamiclink]



You can join the event on our Discord server or follow us on Twitch so you don't miss the opportunity to ask us anything!


For the FIRST TIME EVER… We're taking things to the next level! 💥
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/a261fab661f68acacb319f2a667ed6c42df5b3b0.png"]

 

But most important, enjoy the update! ^^



~Kiki❤

notes.title: 🤡 It's April Fools' Day! (Mini-Update!)
notes.notes:
[hr][/hr]🥳 April fool! 

Howdy Flippers!

Today, we bring you a little something to make your April Fools' Day more fun!
This is our first official "Mini-Update" - that's our new term to describe some of the smaller content additions to House Flipper 2.

[previewyoutube=hKiMi6kEubs;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]📋 Let's take a quick look at the changelog:

New:
• 6 April fools-related items so you can prank someone!
• A new mug with custom picture functionality!

Changes:
• We lost a batch of our sound files, but we MacGyvered smth up overnight, and we're working on a more permanent solution. Be patient. (47 new sounds, but you can actually switch back to the original ones in the main menu! Only available on April 1st)

Fixes:
• Pinnacove suburbs achievement is now correctly recognized.
• Fixed unremovable sills in the recently added house, "The Alligator Bar" in Old Pinnacove. The fix applies only to newly bought houses.

Co-op changes:
• You can now disconnect from a co-op game using the Back button during loading (after confirming in a pop-up). Yes, now this is a feature, not a bug!
• Additional gameplay elements now synchronize properly: wall finish material held in hand, as well as paint roller mode and color.
• Third-person animations have been added for switching the cleaning tools and spray usage.
• Added additional notifications for "Lobby Full" and "Local Connection Not Possible".
• Crossplay status can now be toggled from the client join view.

Co-op fixes:
• Fixed time of day synchronization.
• If the host is in the main menu, clients will also be placed in the main menu upon joining.
• If a player joins while others are still connecting or cleaning windows, they will no longer find them in an awkward position or animation.
• Cleaning the same stain is no longer slower when multiple players clean it together. Teamwork makes the dream work, not the job harder!

❗ Additionally, we saved you from potential malicious features:
• Removed your favourite "before and after" gallery because at least 3 players didn't like it.
• Removed the co-op mode so you can finally enjoy playing alone in peace.
• All your mod.io houses got deleted because we forgot to pay our monthly mod.io premium subscription... what an awesome chance to upload new player creations!
• All textures are now one color (gray) to boost performance.
• Removed paint roller – now you must dip your hands in paint and slap the walls manually.
• Fixed a bug where only cold water was flowing from the taps.
• Removed all houses larger than 25m² or containing more than 20 items or 5 light sources – these could lead to uncontrollable crashes.
• Added an "ive-got-a-crash-on-you" command so you can now controllably crash your game as much as you like! (use at your own risk)



This marks our second step of the Q1 / Q2 2025 House Flipper 2 Roadmap.
What comes next is one of the biggest events of the year for the House Flipper Franchise, so make sure to stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/2cf78324ae532cd4b13688434be38a8275b00106.png

Additionally, keep in mind that you still have about 2 weeks to join our most recent Community Contest, which is actually all about some crazy April Fools' ideas!

Check it out by clicking HERE or on the image below:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/631c16b21a11ca0b4ae7cd0993f4e3ba7da6197f.png

Hope to see you in-game today! Enjoy this Mini-Update, and have a wonderful day!

notes.title: 🌼 The Garden Update! - Free Major Update #7
notes.notes:
🐝 The Garden Update is OUT and will provide exciting new tools and items![hr][/hr]
You can now download it for free (should happen automatically) and prepare yourself for some backyard work!

[previewyoutube=wo8nSz4X948;full][/previewyoutube]
This also marks our first step on our House Flipper 2 Q1/Q2 2025 Roadmap:
https://steamcommunity.com/games/1190970/announcements/detail/627792097481588797

Thank you so much for all your feedback here on Steam, as well as on Canny.io. Many of your ideas and suggestions are included in this update, and we're super proud to work with our community on bringing new content to House Flipper 2.


📑 Let's check out the changelog![hr][/hr]
New:
 A new job: "Setting my new garden straight" in Old Pinnacove, unlocked after completing "New walls, new me".
 A new house: "The Alligator Bar" in Old Pinnacove, unlocked after finishing the new job.
 Gallery with saved Before & After photos! Now you can admire (or regret) your renovation decisions anytime.
 Lawn mowing! Available in the tool menu after completing the new job, or by buying the lawn mower in the store.
 A Sandbox mode tool to set up lawn mowing quests. Set it down and players will have to mow the lawn until it's Tidy or lower.
 Over 200 new items! (See below for details)
 A new Sandbox mode tool called Visual Effects - for adding effects like falling leaves :)
 New trash types! Including eggshells and more leftover pizza
 Items can be locked and won't be unlocked until you find the key! Set this up in Sandbox/Edit Level mode with the Edit Wiring tool. Connect the Key (from the store) to an item like a door. Players in Flipper mode will have to find the key to open the door! Perfect for puzzles and other mysteries ;)
 New main menu for spring :)
 Sort items in the store by size

Changes:
 Disabling automatic Sandbox saves also disables autosaves when returning to the main menu. Be careful! Save manually if necessary!
 The Quests view in the tablet shows how many rooms still have tasks left
 Houses and jobs now feature subtle visual effects like falling leaves, for added atmosphere :)
 Windows can be cleaned from either side.
 Window cleaning requires you to only clean the visibly dirty parts
 New loading screen tips
 Flipper Tool/Duplicate now has an option to "Open in store" for items. Flipper Tool/Copy style still has "Open in store" for surface finishes like paint and wallpaper.
 "Just like dominoes" perk for surface finishes now shows lines in the direction you're tiling
 Some developer codes have been disabled. That's for your safety – sorry!
 Various UI and gamepad improvements.
 Refreshed the whole mod.io view
 Added SSO login support for mod.io

Item changes:
 Color palettes begin with bright Pure colors and end with Drab
 Added new TV channels including, a broken screen and NO SIGNAL
 Billiard balls can all be placed into the billiard triangle
 "Building molding Jungfrau" pieces now have new names to differentiate between the types. Say hello to the Arch, Cube, Prism and others!
 Path rocks and slabs sink into the ground 

Over 200 items! Including:
 4 new patterns for wallpapers and furniture
 4 new surface finishes
 2m and 4m ladders
 Doorbells - ring ring!
 4 new garden fences
 Swing chairs and a hammock for chilling in the garden
 Garden decorations and accessories - hose, birdbath, figurines etc.
 Garden paths! Lay them down with path rocks or path slabs that sink into the ground
 Garden constructions! Decks, pavilions, arches etc.
 A cozy new bike
 Ornamental plants - Ficus tree, ZZ plant
 Shrubs and trees - Lilac, Cherry blossom in many size variations
 38 new lamps in several sets, mainly for Skadi, Futuro, Homefort, and Extravaganza
 Resizable LED light strip!
 Modular sauna set, including a dedicated door, floor panels, benches, heaters and accessories
 Public bathroom set, including hand dryers and a urinal
 A massage table
 Many spice jars and spice racks to spice up the kitchen
 A bedroom set for Skadi/Kirsikkapuu
 2 beds without frames 
 Patio seating and coffee table for Valenti/Chambord
 Living room seating and tables for Homefort/Byron
 Many standing custom picture frames 
 New posters, decorative eggs, figurines, and wall decor
 3 arcade machines
 Air hockey set
 Some new tools like wrenches
 First aid and fire extinguisher kits

Co-op:
 Player characters have profile pictures in the lobby.
 Emotes! Communicate without words!
 Player nicknames appear above their heads. No more guessing who's who.
 When loading or switching parcels, if something goes wrong, players will no longer get stuck in an infinite loading screen — they will be gracefully disconnected instead.
 Most achievements work in co-op mode (only one last one left to implement).

Fixes:
 Fixed placement issues with moldings. They should behave now.
 [Assembly] The cursor properly hides when using a hammer.
 [Assembly] Screw progress is visible.


🏆 We've also just launched a new Community Contest![hr][/hr]
Click on the image below or on this LINK to check out all the details. This time, the theme is more unique than ever, and related to the upcoming April Fools' Day! Try it out and win some awesome prizes!

notes.title: ❄️ Winter Update + Co-op Open Beta! 🎁
notes.notes:
Oh my, this title is already so exciting!
Here's the last couple of months of our work! We love bringing you holiday-themed updates, and this year, our ambitious plan was to put in extra effort to also give you a chance to play House Flipper 2 together with your loved ones just before the Winter Holidays! 💖

With this Steam Announcement, we bring you all the info you need about:

 The Winter Update,
 Co-op Open Beta,
 The first House Flipper 2 DLC,
 The Coziest Christmas Community Contest! (and the winners of our previous contest!)
[previewyoutube=kUVr2EYbgs8;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=f4km4C60OqE;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
🌨️ Let's start with The Winter Update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/3325782ea9482e221328241c0632a5f9e9e3b518.jpg

New:
• A truly magical Christmas job!
• A very Merry House!
• A snowy environment (available to choose in Architect Mode)!
• Winter fun! There’s something exciting about the snowy atmosphere outside… Can you find it?
• Sled assembly!
• 260 new items:
• For some reason... rain boots!
• 9 new doors including wardrobe doors, bi-fold doors, a new door frame, and double sliding doors
• 9 new patterns - used for wallpapers and items
• Traditional festive dishes including Yule logs and pierogi
• Presents and wrapping paper :)
• Snowmen and snowballs - give them a throw!
• Greeting cards you can customize with your own pictures
• Resizable fairy lights
• Christmas trees! Choose your baubles, chain, tree top, and fairy light color <3
• Christmas tree stands for the trees
• 14 types of garlands
• Fir branches and mistletoe
• 3 new sculptures
• 2 new pillow sizes!
• 2 new picture frames
• Christmas ornaments and an ornament stand
• Christmas wall decor and a wall decor stand
• Pine cones and orange slices
• Christmas stockings to hang on your fireplace
• 6 cute winter lanterns
• Christmas crackers, figurines, and a nutcracker
• A table runner
• Letter and number balloons - hello 2025!
• Winter sports! Ice skates, sled, ski boots
• 9 adorable night lights
• Blackberry and raspberry bushes
• Holly bushes and a holly tree
• Poinsettia plants
• 20 snowy versions of spruce, maple, and fir trees
• 8 wardrobe pieces for those walk-in wardrobes
• Full-length kitchen cabinets without the oven ;)
• 4 new space-themed posters
• Binoculars and a telescope
• Screwdriver complete with a screwdriver rack
• Construction support post
• 50 broken windows of many different sizes
• A broken balcony door and broken sign

Changes:
• New perk ('Just like dominoes') for tiling in a straight line, along with improvements to this mechanic!
• All lights have a new light mode - RGB.
• Brushed aluminium has expanded its colour palette.
• You can now skip a single line of text messages during the job summary
• Houses requiring completion of specific jobs are now locked with a padlock in the On Sale tab.
• Items on quest lists are now much better organized ;) 

Fixes:
• Resolved a bug causing screen blur and game freezing when accessing materials in the store with the Flipper tool, which were unavailable in Story Mode.
• Custom pictures with overly long file paths are now ignored to prevent infinite loading.

Co-op changes:
• First batch of third-person-perspective animations for Story mode.
• A brand new lobby screen.
• Cross-play! Play with friends from other platforms!
• The co-op region is now part of the lobby code.
• You can now see what the other player is buying in the store, before they place the item.
• A pop-up now appears when a connection is rejected due to mismatched cross-play settings between the host and client.

Co-op fixes:
• The client sees quests while playing Custom Jobs in Sandbox mode.
• Trash bags no longer stick to the player (at last).
• Full trash bags cannot be taken from the player holding them.
• Job emails are no longer accessible when playing Custom Jobs in Sandbox mode. 
• Windows cannot be opened if they are being cleaned by another player.


[hr][/hr]
🎁 The Co-op Open Beta is here, and all the House Flipper 2 players are invited!

We feel like that's a BIG one! The Winter Update might be even cooler when flipping together with others! The Co-op feature works with up to 4-players and is fully cross-platform! Remember you need to own House Flipper 2 in order to join the beta!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/b1fc7b8e1d03de71bdbc58484f915f9f63b2f3d3.png

To join in, you only have to go to the House Flipper 2 Steam Store Page, find the "Join the HF2 - Co-op Playtest" field, and click the "Request Access" button there:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/5982b720ae7b46bd895b22d708f4938495ffb623.png
The access should be granted instantly! Remember that these are the beta tests for the full release of the Co-op Feature, bugs and crashes may be happening!

👀 The first House Flipper 2 DLC will be FREE and based around CO-OP!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363370/House_Flipper_2__Coop_DLC

This DLC will bring a special set of brand-new houses and jobs tailored specifically towards cooperation enthusiasts. Whether you’re on PC or console, with the planned cross-platform support, up to four players will be able to team up in both story and sandbox modes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/ebf966a9227d4d11ed5fc73c7e95e1d15a9c2fc2.png

🔥 Remember the the Frozen District Publisher Sale is still ON FIRE!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/694d89c3438e668771aa0740ee407931ecd90028.pnghttps://steamcommunity.com/games/1190970/announcements/detail/4471607136529416423


[hr][/hr]
🔴 Last but not least, today is a dev livestream day!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/410c3f21ca68b23d5011831109172198793226c7.png

Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/frozen_district

Have a wonderful holiday season! 💝

notes.title: ☃️ Major Update Preview - Cozy Christmas! 🎄
notes.notes:
Ho ho ho! 🎅

The winter season is getting wild so here we come with the final Major Update of 2024 that will allow you to start your Christmas preparations in House Flipper 2! With this update, we have quite a lot of stuff for ya, both content and news-wise.
Let's unwrap the presents and take a peek at what's inside:


🎁 The "Cozy Christmas" Update comes on December 12![hr][/hr]
We're delivering a sweet chunk of content to make your snowy house designs possible! In this announcement, you can expect a bit of a sneak peek, and on December 12, you'll be able to download the update for free and check out all of its content!  Along with the release you might want to go through the patch-notes list and hang out with us on the Xmas dev stream! A new Community Contest is also on the way!


So the first thing to show you should be snow... LOTS OF SNOW!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/4521b774b88b5d4dbc3ca3514399e9ca12887dfc.jpgYup, that will need some more lights and garlands! MAKE IT SHINE!


We're throwing in a bunch of new items (260 of them to be exact!) like Christmas decorations, cute nightlights, and much more!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/2bc8a74482e4174390e2d964d5e541485b0da264.jpgUndeniably cute!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/2336faf168a84737cc91c53674eca259f210506f.jpgWe've really put some effort into bringing you options to choose from!


And a little something for the assembly lovers!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/5a070e44d91780971c99e423b2bc2b4f369a5b75.jpgBuild it yourself!

As always, we'll post a full list of additions and changes once the update comes out on December 12. In addition to new content, you can expect some minor fixes and quality-of-life improvements.



🔴 Remember about the upcoming Xmas Dev Livestream! [hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/410c3f21ca68b23d5011831109172198793226c7.png
A bunch of spicy topics on this one, right?

December 12, 6:00 PM CET! Be there or be square!

notes.title: 🎃 "Bewitching Renovations" - Major Update #5 OUT NOW 🦇
notes.notes:
🕯️ The fifth major update for House Flipper 2 is live![hr][/hr]
Download it (should happen automatically), get ready for a spooktacular gaming session, and check out what's been added to the game!

[previewyoutube=PMgZV70k4PY;full][/previewyoutube]

Halloween updates have a special place in our hearts, we always had lots of fun doing those each year, and this one is no exception! 👻

We are so grateful for all of your support. With every major update, the content for House Flipper 2 becomes so much more diverse, and it's all thanks to your suggestions and feedback!
We're currently deep into  our latest roadmap, and that means that you can expect some fresh info for the development journey of House Flipper 2 to arrive in the upcoming months! Meanwhile, make sure to check our feature board on Canny.io and vote for your favorite ideas! Keep in mind that this board is one of our main tools regarding planning the content for the game - your votes matter!



📜 Changelog time![hr][/hr]
New:
 New job: "My house might scare away all the little ghosts" in Old Pinnacove. (Unlocks after Cleaning up after the flood or More light, please)
 Brand new property: "Vacant Private School" in Old Pinnacove. Don’t let the creaky floors scare you off.
 Over 230 new items! (Details below. Don’t worry, no trick items here. Or are there?)
 Character customization expanded! New character models and pronoun options.
 New assembly: Candelabra – light up your nights with some spooky elegance.
 Perk "Can of All Colors" under the Paint category. You can choose any color you want!
 New Buyers tab (unlocked after buying your first house).
 New vacuumable objects added to sandbox mode.
Over 230 new items:
 13 new windows, including a brand new gothic style
 Gothic architectural elements - ceiling panels, wall panels, mouldings and corbels!
 4 new gothic fences
 4 door frames and 2 doors
 Misc decorations such as...a barrel, fireplace logs, fireplaces, globes, a clock, a display case and a storage chest
 Custom color paint! Unlock the perk and paint with any color of the rainbow
 3 kinds of stone, 1 kind of wood and 3 new patterns - also available as surface finishes and wallpaper
 Several witchy items for all your magical needs - potions, cauldrons and spoooky candy containers
 Carved pumpkins and a witch hat you can put on them
 A witch's broom and matching broom stand
 Halloween paper garlands
 A gothic living room set
 A gothic library office set
 A gothic candelabra set
 A lovely cozy patio set
 Hanging herbs
 10 bathroom accessories for all beard-bearing people
 6 door mats and 1 bath mat
 Paper money stacks, cash register, a store counter and refrigerated store displays
 Pizza board and pizza peel
 A mannequin and clothes rack
 A larger coffee machine and portafilter
 A custom text sticky note - write your own!
 Greeting cards
A plethora of plants such as:
 Lenten roses
 Nandina plants in purple and red
 Cherry plum trees
 Corkscrew filbert trees
 Pine trees
 Willow trees

Changes:
 Creating unpacking quests in Sandbox Mode is now easier. Buy the unpacking box and use the Hands tool to put items in and take them out!  
 Building walls in concrete pouring mode now turns the finished product to concrete instead of bricks!
 Tiling walls with the same tiles will now highlight the overlap. 
 You can now see the whole list of locked assemblies.
 The assembly panel is updated with arrow-key camera rotation and better gamepad support.
 The star timer for assemblies has been extended.
 You can now sit on even more benches and chairs.
 Instruments now make a sound when you press 'E'.
 You can now throw trash bags into the big commercial trash bin.
 Trespassing trees have been removed from Pinnacove Suburbs. Be free from your neighbours tree choices.
 Herbs now have an alternative dried version, just in case you're crafting potions.
 Cobweb rework – easier to spot, and they no longer mysteriously fall on their own.
 Added a sound for quest completions in rooms. You'll hear about your success!
 Resizable items now have a filter in the store.
 Added a saturation slider in settings – turn down the creepiness or crank it up!
 Settings now come with descriptions.
 Added tooltips for color names.
 New loading screen tips!
 mod.io: Added a progress bar for mod downloads & installs.
 mod.io: Filters added for browsing houses.

Fixes:
 Garage door stains now move along with the doors.
 Placing fences has been improved.
 Fixed the reset of the refresh rate at the game start.
 Fixed some collision issues between trash bags and players.
 Selling items by holding now correctly highlights sellable items.

Co-op:
 Tools unlocked in multiplayer campaigns are now available in single-player campaigns too.
 Hosts can now kick clients.
 An automatic answering machine is available for all players.
 Players no longer collide with each other.
 The first version of "Floor is Lava" – players can see each other, but only your time matters at the finish line.
 Fixed model resetting in third-person view.


🧟 New Community Contest with a special sponsor: LogitechG! 💙[hr][/hr]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/8525f0f0f089b5d45ff5380d773c2cb577a02675.png

Come up with a monster-themed property (it can be based on ANY monster - one you know or just made up!) and on top of that make sure that the house shares some spicy details about the monstrous host's Halloween plans! Are the witches meeting up for a party? Or is it a bunch of banshees planning a ball? Did someone mention a corpse cookout?!

BONUS Giveaway for all the participants: We have two additional G309 LIGHTSPEED Gaming Mice that will make their way to two lucky contest participants!

Kudos to the guys at Logitech G, it's awesome to reward our community with some suuuuper fancy gear!

notes.title: 😎 "Summer in Old Pinnacove" - Major Update #4! 🍹
notes.notes:
[hr][/hr]2 days ago we greeted you with an update preview, and today we're ready to roll! 🥵

This update is the 4th House Flipper 2 major content update, and it is the first step on our recently released House Flipper 2 Roadmap - Part 2, and you should definitely check it out because there's so much more to come! Let's get to all the news, because we've got plenty of that for you today!


[previewyoutube=lJ3tff_8H7k;full][/previewyoutube]While you're downloading the update, check out the list of patch notes:


New:
 Get ready to explore Old Pinnacove, a brand-new region with a fresh downtown vibe!
 Dive into a new job in the new region, where you'll help Simon, an allergy sufferer, with his apartment makeover.
 Check out a charming new apartment in the heart of a historic tenement building.
 150 new items! (Hold onto your toolboxes! Details below).
 13 new images for Custom Pictures.
 Get an SMS from your client after finishing a job. Because who doesn't love a good debrief?
 Enjoy the new visual and sound effects when bags bounce off the invisible boundary wall. It's like magic but with bags!
 Now you can tweak Chromatic Aberration in the settings.
 Introducing the "Unstuck" button in the pause menu (under escape). Perfect for those moments when you find yourself wedged between items or walls.
 Say hello to a new company for items, FixeD! Looks familiar?
﻿

150 new items:
- 12 fun beach toys for your inner child.
- Flip-flops, sunglasses, and other summer essentials.
- Invasive weed species to spice up your garden battles.
- A cozy campfire for those summer nights.
- Downtown-themed goodies: benches, fire hydrants, traffic lights.
- Stylish awnings to keep things cool.
- Bigger balcony doors.
- Decorative moss and vintage suede - now available in Story mode.
- A bunch of colorful rhododendrons.
- Adorable bee-themed kitchen accessories (Pipit).
- Cozy Rosie patio furniture (Sandpiper). Perfect for lounging!
- 20 doors of different widths. Open up to new possibilities!
- 6 new towels. Drying off has never been this stylish!
- Store rack shelf and commercial fridge for your budding business empire.
- Classic instruments to bring out your inner musician.
- A new bedroom set for Valenti (Windsor), featuring a secret door. Shh, don't tell anyone!
Changes:
 Curtains can now be stretched downwards.
 Open and close curtains with just a press of a button!
 Feel free to place items on the gazebo and scaffolding.
 Buying multiple lights? They keep their settings now.
 Copy surface styles on architectural elements, just like you copy wall styles.
 A friendly reminder before deleting old progress when starting a new game.
 Jobs in the archive now have a "continue" button, so you can pick up right where you left off.
 Refrigerators, microwaves, and ovens now come with internal lighting.
 Larger items now require a longer click to sell. No more accidental sales!
 Store categories are now sorted with intention, not semi-alphabetically.
Fixes:
 Fixed the text input in the store search field, especially improving functionality in certain modes or on specific devices.
 The ceiling fan in Jonesboro has been corrected to be properly resizable.



🌸 Fairytale Community Contest Winners reveal![hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=-uzJ8ntXBT0;full][/previewyoutube]
Congrats to all the winners! It was a stunning show of creativity and Sandbox Mode mastery! 🙀

We couldn't pass on highlighting a couple of projects as "honorable mentions" because they were just so incredibly close to making it to top 6!

notes.title: 🌷 The Free Spring Update is LIVE! (with a spicy sale!) 🌷
notes.notes:
⭐ Time for our first major House Flipper 2 update![hr][/hr]
Thanks to all the suggestions from our community, we recently managed to plan everything out and come up with a roadmap that contains all the content we want you to have!

Today we're bringing you the first big chunk of it!

[previewyoutube=BDPNLQ94Q5w;full][/previewyoutube]

Also today, the first major House Flipper 2 sale (a 20% discount!) hits the Steam Store:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1190970/House_Flipper_2/ 


🗒️ Take a look at the patch notes
[hr][/hr]
New:
 "Healthier lifestyle for a change" - a brand new job!
 "House left behind" - a new house you can buy after completing the job!
 240 new items (details below) 📋
 Resizing - now available in Story Mode for certain items! Look for it in the Flipper Tool's “Change style” panel. Resizable items can be recognized in the store by looking at the icon with two arrows, shown in the top left corner of the item preview in the store.
 Resizeable items from the “Sandbox only” category were moved to “Architectural elements/Other” and are also available in Story Mode. Say hello to columns and floor mouldings!
 Sell roofs and stairs in Story Mode (hold LMB)! Also works in the Sandbox “Play” and “Test property” modes.
 Certain items like fireplaces and candles can now light up! 🔥
 Textiles are now available as surface finish options in Sandbox Mode!
 A new perk - "Well deserved rest" - which will let you sleep in beds.
 4 new special buyers (for a total of 11)
 Two new assemblies - a hanging and a standing kitchen cabinet.
 Toy trains placed on tracks are now interactive! Choo choo!
 A new sound for window cleaning.
 Flower petals - a new vacuumable dirt.
 [UI] Progress bar for jobs with a fancy animation when all 3 stars are obtained.
 [UI] You can now complete jobs with a button in the Quest tab.

New items include:
- Step ladder 
- 10 cute plant pots 🦊
- 5 new types of plants 
- 12 new spring-themed patterns - can be used on items or as wallpapers!
- More green vines
- Backpacks, bags, shoes, gloves, and hats 🧢
- Thermostats, air purifiers, and a vacuum-cleaning robot
- Pillows!
- Curtains and window blinds!
- A smaller version of the ceiling spotlight “Knicknacks”
- 2 new spotlights
- Poster “Oddities” for your custom poster needs
- A resizable cube called “Building molding Jungfrau”
- 12 new toys for kids
- Sports equipment - badminton, golf, and for the gym
- Accessories for painters 🧑‍🎨
- Accessories for taking care of hair
- Valenti dinner set
- Valenti bathroom accessories
- Valenti hallway set
- Extravaganza office set 👁️ 👄 👁️
- Skadi living room set
- The Cent shelving unit

Changes:
 The game now stops responding to inputs when you minimize it.
 The store sorting option for dates are now less confusingly called “Date: from newest” and “Date: from oldest”. Useful for seeing what’s new in the update 👀
 Clothes will now be easier to hang on hangers.
 The auction fee is now lower for cheaper houses and higher for more expensive ones.
 Fixes to the trampoline! (Say goodbye to unwanted space trips and hello to dynamic diagonal dives - I'm sure this won't come in handy 🌋)
 Textiles such as carpet tiles have been moved to the right category in the store (Surface finishes) and have been fully translated.
 Reworked some buttons in the “Change style” panel to make them easier to understand (e.g., for plants - "Soil" - "Yes/No").
 Items from the "Sandbox Only" category can no longer be used in a “To Buy” quest in jobs.
 Stains placed in Sandbox Mode will now disappear automatically if they're small enough.
 We've optimized stain highlights while using the "Dirt management" tool.
 The new perk - “Well deserved rest” lets you control the time of day in a house you own. You’ll do this by sleeping in a bed, changing the time to morning or night. Important! Changing the “Game time” option in the settings will only have a visual effect on clocks.
 Changing the time in the “Property settings” tab in Sandbox mode now also changes the time while making a level as well. No more going in and out of the “Test property” mode to see if the sun is high enough!
 The progression of the Mount Everest achievement now properly scales with the size of your paint roller
 [UI] Added an animation when hovering over the series or name of an item, and the company logo in the store. This shows you can click on them for easy searching.
 [UI] The auction fee is now shown on the button for putting a house up for auction
 When building walls in Sandbox Mode, the preview of the chosen material is now bigger.
 The "unstuck" and "reset-to-spawn-position" commands are now visible in the console (F11).

Fixes:
 Further advancements with our war on corrupted save files (we're winning, aren't we?)
 Improved recognition of presets when switching between them in the “Change style” panel
 Pool balls are now arranged in the correct order in the “Change style” panel
 Building walls on stains should now clean the stains
 The game now correctly calculates the amount of money paid for the auction immediately after putting a house up for auction
 Fixed the spray VFX
 The "Spray" tooltip shows up only when the "Cleaning spray" perk is active
 Removed the Confounded Face emoji from the bottom right corner of the screen 😖. Bye friend!
[hr][/hr]⚠️⚠️⚠️
Some of you may be disappointed with the lack of a Before/After feature. Overall, this has been one of the most popular requests since House Flipper 2 came out, so we fully understand that!
To be frank, we already had something ready, a bit more than a prototype of this feature, but we felt that instead of releasing it now, we wanna take our time and bring it to you once we're fully happy with the results! From the development perspective, this feature isn't as simple as it may seem, and considering how many players are interested in it, we aim to bring it to a higher standard!

[hr][/hr]

It's a big one for us, and we'd love to hear from you regarding all the new content!

If you have any suggestions, make sure to let us know! - our Steam Discussions or the House Flipper Discord are probably your best bets!
You're also welcome to visit our feature board on Canny.io!

Last but not least, check out this brand new bundle!
Hairdresser Simulator just came out, and if it's something you might enjoy, go show them some love! 🤗

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/38867/Hairdresser_Simulator__House_Flipper_2/

[hr][/hr]
Have lots of fun with the Spring Update, and make sure to celebrate the upcoming spring season! 🌼

notes.title: Maintenance Update - saving the save files! 💾
notes.notes:
Today we've refreshed the game with a maintenance update, bringing you some much-needed fixes and improvements. We mostly focused on the matter of save file malfunctions, as some players experienced some heartbreaking loses of their House Flipper 2 progress. :C

If you encounter any save file issues after this update, use this guide!


[hr][/hr]🗒️ Take a look at the patch notes:


Changes:
Welcome to the era of transparency. The changelog window is here to keep you in the loop!
Added a main menu news section aka. The Flipper News!
Added a memo about our social media channels upon exiting the game! Join our community, we have memes about walls and roofs!
The "Ryan" Microphone can now be put on various furniture pieces.
Blocked the ability to put certain symbols in the Store's search bar.

Fixes:
A save files migration has been implemented to address the progress loss issues.
The pesky autosave has been tamed and now behaves like a well-trained pet. Sit. Stay. Save.
Fixed the amount of money not saving properly in some specific cases.
The "Start playtest" option in the Sandbox Mode has been changed to "Test property (no saving)", to more accurately represent what it's for.
Using the transform tool to rotate roofs shouldn't cause problems anymore.
The transparency settings for stains created with the "stains and dirt" tool should now apply properly.
The button tooltips in the tutorial should now be displayed properly when using a controller.
Filled some gaps in the game's localization.
Town environment optimization improvements.

[hr][/hr]📌 What's our next move?


We're constantly working on the first Major House Flipper 2 Update which is going to come in March!
We already mentioned the Spring Update in our recent House Flipper 2 Status Report as well as the House Flipper 2 Roadmap. Go check those out if you haven't seen them already!


Also, today we've heard some new spicy information regarding the release date of the Hairdresser Simulator that we've talked about in the past!
The Hairvolution is right around the corner, as the game will be releasing on the 6th of March 2024!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1330560/ 

The devs also let us know that a FREE DLC called "Beards and Mustaches" is coming out in the second quarter of 2024!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2782930/Hairdresser_Simulator__Beards_and_Mustaches_DLC/



[hr][/hr]Have a great rest of the week!
Cheers! 💙

notes.title: First ever House Flipper 2 Feature Update!
notes.notes:
🎙️ The last couple of days were full of your suggestions!

Since the release, you guys have been very active on various player-developer communication channels.
Thanks to that, we were able to discover some overlooks on our side and decided to act quickly before the winter holiday break!

For the last week, we tried gathering as much feedback as possible, especially keeping a close eye on our  new feature request board on Canny.io!

[hr][/hr]If you don't know what Canny.io is, it's a platform where our players can:
 See what we have planned for the future of House Flipper 2
 Influence this plan by commenting on and upvoting the things that they think are a priority.
 Create posts that contain player ideas for new content. These posts can then be upvoted by the rest of the community members and implemented into the House Flipper 2 roadmap.

Click the banner below or one of the above links to join the fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42979328/35de3c1ae8b0e60c39d78465ddbdecb2634f383a.png

[hr][/hr]
📜 The Feature Update patch notes:

Today, we're delivering some simple, yet very effective quality-of-life features which were instantly requested by our community right after the release:

 Added a Hold / Toggle option inside the Settings > Gameplay Tab. This feature works with:- painting
- general cleaning
- window cleaning
- wall building
- vacuuming(Important: the tooltips will still suggest that you're using the hold option, don't worry about it, we'll change that soon!)

 Added options for inverted X/Y mouse movement settings in the Settings > Gameplay Tab.
 Added WASD tooltips when painting and cleaning windows.
 Added a popup suggesting lower graphics settings in case of a game crash.
 Optimized window cleaning to work better on low-end GPUs.
 The game now triggers an autosave upon entering the assembly mechanic.
 Fixed disappearing assembly elements!
 Fixed the issues encountered during the drilling phase in the assembly mechanic.
 Property photos are now getting automatically exported along with uploading the property to Mod.io
 The popup about not being able to sell your parents' house is now displayed properly.
 Added support for all keyboard layouts (yikes!).
 Added variety regarding TV shows on different properties.
 Reflections should no longer go crazy on your GPU memory.
 Optimization improvements for various stains.
 BIGGER FONTS for Steam Deck users!


We also performed a couple of tests regarding motion sickness in House Flipper 2
Generally, what seems to be working is:
 Turning off FSR (but we still love AMD!)
 Turning off Motion Blur
 Disabling V-Sync and setting your fps to match your monitor refresh rate.


[hr][/hr]
That's it, folks! We will be back with more updates in 2024!
Cheers, have a wonderful rest of the week! ❤️
